liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (4 reviews): Playin' runs past twenty-five minutes; Reviewer believes this Playin' opens Dick's Picks 31 and calls that first track worth the purchase alone [7][8][14][16]
- **Weather Report Suite** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises the complete Weather Report Suite as one of the best tunes; Bobby slightly fumbles the suite's intro [16][17]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer likes the show opening with Bertha [12]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer hears the Peggy-O as aching and minimalist [11]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jack Straw is cohesive and seemed to invite longer stretching out [11]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Jerry noodles during El Paso [11]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Let It Grow and the jam after it stand out; Keith plays well off Jerry, with about ten minutes of meltdown before Wharf Rat [7]
- **US Blues** (1 review): Reviewer singles out US Blues as great in 1974 [15]

## The recordings

- **gd74-08-04.aud-moore.weiner.20369.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 233 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [1]
- **gd74-08-04.sbd.sacks.1574.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 208 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1974-08-04.sbd.unknown.1631.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 208 min [3]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar has problems on the first two tracks, Beat It On Down The Line and Roses [3]
- **gd1974-08-04.aud.moore.weiner.gdADT.9112.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 206 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds it a solid audience recording; Of two audience recordings, this one is clearest and sharpest; the other sounds muffled [12][18]
- **gd1974-08-04.mtx.seamons.100653.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 231 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [5]

## Around the show

- Attendee says the Wall of Sound PA took about half the first set to dial in; vocals cleared by the fourth or fifth song [9]
- Taper sat front row of the balcony, audience right, about halfway back from the stage [5]
- Reviewer calls this matrix the best version available other than the Dick's Picks release [14]
- Playin' is very good but not the best of 1974 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-08-04.aud-moore.weiner.20369.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Mark Cohen and Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Jerry Moore taped with two AKG D-1000E mics into a Sony 152 deck, on Maxell cassettes with Dolby B; Mark Cohen made the analog-to-DAT transfer; Noah Weiner converted the DAT to SHN/CD [1]
- **gd74-08-04.sbd.sacks.1574.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Dick's Picks 31 uses part of disc 1 and all of disc 2 from this show [17]
- **gd1974-08-04.sbd.unknown.1631.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: SBD>MR>DAT>CDR [3]
- **gd1974-08-04.aud.moore.weiner.gdADT.9112.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: AudMC > DAT > WAV > SHN and AudMC > R? > Beta Hi-Fi PCM > CASS > WAV > CD > EAC > SHN [4]. Also: Set one lineage was noted on the DAT; the second-set DAT was lower quality, so its lineage is uncertain; An alternate audience-cassette source patched missing tracks and cuts; taper is assumed to be Jerry Moore [4]
- **gd1974-08-04.mtx.seamons.100653.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [5]. Also: Source disk came from Bob Fishman; Jerry Moore taped with two AKG mics into a Sony 152 deck; Mics were mounted in a V on a telescoping pole extended six feet, aimed at the proscenium wings [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead RARE Philadelphia 1974 Concert Poster | #33405429](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-rare-philadelphia-1974-concert) [20]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [Grateful Dead Poster 1974-08-04 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/grateful-dead-poster-1974-08-04-04/) [21]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1974-08-04 Sun Civic Convention Hall Auditorium, Philadelphia, PA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1398747154146/grateful-dead-1974-08-04-sun-civic) [22]
